purpose: Teach: 捉える/深海/追放/パンク/捏造/形跡/失調/大名

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、警察、絶対、容疑者の動き、絶対、捉える、絶対、ことができました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We were able to locate and track the suspect's movements throughout this case. Thank you for your diligence.
lines.style: Measured, professional delivery. Direct eye contact. Each clause lands with quiet authority. Slight pause before 'thank you'—genuine, not ceremonial. Steady breath throughout.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、深海、絶対、ケーブル、絶対、犯罪、絶対、警察、絶対、捜査中ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So with this case—the investigation is still ongoing with the deep-sea cable angle and the criminal element. We appreciate your work.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly uncertain inflection. Leans forward slightly, as if thinking aloud. Genuinely curious about where this leads. Softer landing on 'appreciate'—sincere without formality.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、容疑者、絶対、追放、絶対、命令、絶対、警察、絶対、執行いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The suspect has been taken into custody and charges have been formally executed by our department. Thank you for your assistance.
lines.style: Formal, clipped phrasing. Each procedural step enunciated clearly. No warmth, but not cold—just official. The gratitude is brief, dutiful, correct.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、回線、絶対、パンク、絶対、警察、絶対、原因究明中ですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The line overload situation—we're still determining the root cause. Your cooperation has been invaluable.
lines.style: Slower pace. Reflective, almost turning the thought over as he speaks. Genuine appreciation in 'invaluable'—not a stock phrase, but felt. Slight trailing-off, leaving space for the puzzle.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、書類、絶対、捏造、絶対、警察、絶対、摘発、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Document fabrication has been identified and prosecuted by the department. We're grateful for your diligence in bringing this forward.
lines.style: Crisp, procedural. Each finding stated as fact. Professional distance maintained. Gratitude is acknowledged but secondary to the report—the work speaks.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、現場の、絶対、形跡、絶対、警察、絶対、保全、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The scene evidence has been secured and preserved according to protocol. Thank you for helping us protect what we found.
lines.style: Calm, methodical. The words come with the weight of careful work. Slight emphasis on 'preserved'—it mattered. The thanks feels earned and genuine, not obligatory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、被害者、絶対、失調、絶対、ケア、絶対、警察、絶対、医療連携、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The victim is receiving coordinated medical and psychological care through our liaison with healthcare providers. We're committed to their recovery.
lines.style: Compassionate but measured. Slight softening on 'victim' and 'recovery'—this is personal, not just procedural. Clear, steady delivery. No rush. The commitment is non-negotiable.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、本気で、絶対、旧、絶対、大名、絶対、家、絶対、文書、絶対、警察、絶対、保護、絶対、されたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The historical documents from the former daimyo house have been secured and are under police protection. We take our responsibility to preserve them seriously.
lines.style: Quiet pride in the work. Deliberate pacing—these documents carry weight. Slight reverence in tone without being overwrought. Closes with firmness: the responsibility is understood and honored.
